tldr: Mercury through the 2nd house brings focus to money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Mercury transiting the 2nd house activates money, resources, values, and self-worth. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports earning and resourcing: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or equating worth with what is owned or earned.
advice: Name the details in the 2nd house deliberately. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
